scope: Broaden S3.7c transform grammar evidence and screen an optional open-source ACIS-producing DXF route.

method.kind: Current project documentation, release notes, and versioned open-source API/source review
method.evidenceBoundary: ACadRust and ezdxf are implementation profiles, not normative ACIS authority. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG AcDs/container linkage and does not specify SAB internals. obj2cad claims are mutable pre-release project claims and were not executed.

observed: ACadRust v0.6.4 documents nine 3x3 values, three translations, a separate scale value, and trailing rotation/reflection/shear hints.
Its placement implementation describes SAB Position triplets plus scale, or a long-string with 13 numeric values.
The pinned ezdxf profile previously reviewed by this plan reads a 12-number literal and reconstructs a Matrix44 column.
The ACadRust release summary reports BricsCAD V20 validation of 18/20 generated files but no per-body expected-transform manifest.
doesNotEstablish: Canonical grammar for all SAB 21800 producers.
Whether scale is folded into ezdxf matrix values or belongs to another profile.
The correct local transform composition, units, or WCS convention.
evidence.planUse: Keep the 12-number, 13-number, triplet-plus-scale, hint, malformed, and unknown shapes as separate raw variants; leave placement unapplied.

observed: A visible AcDs helper fabricates SAB from ASM magic, arbitrary bytes, and a terminator.
A planar-body DWG roundtrip checks entity and ACIS-data survival.
doesNotEstablish: Valid SAB topology/B-rep semantics for fabricated payload.
Independent expected transformed coordinates or native acceptance.
evidence.planUse: Count as carrier/ordering controls only; score B-rep and application acceptance separately.

observed: The pre-release advertises its own SAT/SAB and DXF R2018 writer, known analytic bodies, and ezdxf/ACadRust readback.
Its README labels DWG and curved surfaces beta until AutoCAD acceptance.
Its DWG writer uses patched ACadRust, so this route is not independent of ACadRust.
doesNotEstablish: A released immutable artifact, execution in this review, AutoCAD acceptance, or general ACIS/DWG support.
evidence.planUse: Optional composed DXF producer candidate only; pin before use, generate an asymmetric model locally, compare independent expected geometry, never fetch/commit its corpus.
